subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly Manila to Chengdu on Air China and head north to Jiuzhaigou. You will visit Diexi Haizi, Songpan Ancient City (outside view) and Jiuzhai Valley National Park (shuttle bus included), then return via Chuanzhusi and Dujiangyan. Four nights are in 4-star hotels, with a private coach and an English-speaking guide. The rate includes four shop visits.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 10–14 2026 to Nov 10–14 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Jinli Walking Street: A traditional-style pedestrian street in Chengdu with snacks, crafts and teahouses.
placeDesc.Broad and Narrow Alley: Chengdu's historic Kuanzhai Alleys of old courtyard houses, now filled with cafes and shops.
placeDesc.IFS Plaza: A modern shopping complex in Chengdu, known for the giant panda sculpture climbing its facade.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping and dining quarter in central Chengdu, built around old temples.
placeDesc.Diexi Haizi: A group of lakes formed after an earthquake in the mountains of northern Sichuan.
placeDesc.Songpan Ancient City: An old walled town on the road to Jiuzhaigou, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Jiuzhai Valley National Park: A mountain nature reserve known for turquoise lakes and waterfalls, toured by shuttle bus.
placeDesc.Tibetan Cultural Village: A Tibetan-style village stop at Chuanzhusi with a tea and silver craft store.
placeDesc.Red Army Long March Monument: A memorial at Chuanzhusi marking the Red Army's Long March route, seen from a distance.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square: A square in Chengdu with a giant selfie-taking panda statue.
placeDesc.South Bridge: A scenic bridge in Dujiangyan Ancient City, popular for riverside photos.
